ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; approximately 90% low-intensity (black/dark grey) and 10% high-intensity (white/light grey) across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black background with high-contrast contiguous white geometric blobs distributed as localized circular clusters in the central-median region and multi-directional linear streaks across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate internal pixel angle of 45-50 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 15% of the total vertical fluke height in the 2D plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged profile with peak-to-valley pixel amplitudes varying between 3 and 12 pixels; continuous serration present across the entire lateral extent of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the interior lobe edges, tapering into a slightly concave sweep toward the distal tips (flukes-up position).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and elliptical high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-20 pixel diameters) scattered globally; high density of clusters located in the central region surrounding the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear pixel disruptions; notable long diagonal streak on the lower-left lobe and a series of parallel vertical-to-oblique rake marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular pixel protrusions and 'frayed' texture on both distal tips, suggesting heavy barnacle colonization or prior physical trauma to the lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three-dimensional, high-texture clusters (white/grey) extending beyond the anatomical trailing edge boundary at the lobe tips.
